## What you're trying
<!-- The experiment, in one or two lines. -->

## The bet (why)
<!-- What you expect to learn or gain, and why it's worth trying. The why is freshest now —
     it's the part you won't be able to reconstruct honestly later. -->

## What "it works" looks like
<!-- The outcome that would count as success. Concrete enough that you'll know if you hit it. -->

## Supporting receipts
<!-- Optional. Anything that makes this worth trying: prior runs, logs, screenshots, links, the
     observation that prompted it. Receipts beat hunches. If there are none yet, say so — that's honest. -->
